title: Koala holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 30 Q58 45 55 55' stroke='#c8f5ff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='20' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='15' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ff9db0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M64 34 L61 37 L67 37 Z' fill='#c81e42'/>
  <!-- koala body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='78' rx='18' ry='17' fill='#9db4d6'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='70' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#8aa0c4' transform='rotate(25 26 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='58' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#8aa0c4' transform='rotate(-40 55 58)'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='93' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#8aa0c4'/>
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='93' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#8aa0c4'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='45' r='20' fill='#b4c8e6'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='23' cy='33' r='9' fill='#b4c8e6'/>
  <circle cx='23' cy='33' r='5' fill='#e8a6b8'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='33' r='9' fill='#b4c8e6'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='33' r='5' fill='#e8a6b8'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='49' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#d8e4f5'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='44' r='3.2' fill='#2b2440'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='44' r='3.2' fill='#2b2440'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='43' r='1' fill='#c8f5ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='43' r='1' fill='#c8f5ff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='52' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#4a3f5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='40.5' cy='51' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#8a7ba8'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M37 57 Q42 61 47 57' stroke='#4a3f5c' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
